selection: first 121 seconds selected before model inference; no result-based sample selection
crop_rule: fixed square selected from source images before inference; no tracking or outcome tuning
gt_timing: CSV Count / 60, matched count and published frame alignment; zero offset; no fitted lag
gt_sync_uncertainty: author reports nearest-frame alignment within 8ms, not independently calibrated by this project; sample CSV has no absolute clock or offset field
evaluation_spectrum: Hann, constant detrend, no zero padding
